why.org_b:finding:01050: This is a critical Log4j Remote Code Execution vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228) with a CVSS of 10.0 and maximum EPSS, representing an immediate risk to the environment.

reasoning: The critical CVE-2021-44228 finding on the app host represents a severe remote code execution vulnerability with maximum exploit probability. Fixing this key finding effectively mitigates the primary attack vector to protect the organization's crown jewels.

input.sql:
SELECT f.id AS finding_id, v.cve, v.cvss, a.hostname, ds.id AS ds_id
FROM findings f
JOIN of ON of.id = f.id
JOIN assets a ON of.dst = a.id
JOIN runs r ON r.src = a.id
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id
JOIN has_vuln hv ON hv.src = s.id AND hv.dst = v.id
JOIN edges e ON e.src = a.id
JOIN datastores ds ON e.dst = ds.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND ds.crown_jewel = true
LIMIT 50;

input.sql:
SELECT f.id AS finding_id, v.cve, v.cvss, a.hostname, ds.id AS ds_id
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON e_of.dst = v.id
JOIN edges e_ds ON e_ds.src = a.id
JOIN datastores ds ON e_ds.dst = ds.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND ds.crown_jewel = true
LIMIT 50;
SELECT e.type, a.hostname, d.id as ds_id FROM edges e JOIN assets a ON e.src = a.id JOIN datastores d ON e.dst = d.id WHERE d.crown_jewel = true;
SELECT e.type, i.name, d.id as ds_id FROM edges e JOIN identities i ON e.src = i.id JOIN datastores d ON e.dst = d.id WHERE d.crown_jewel = true;
